answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it may earn, and let that bond be slashed when two identities are caught sharing one device key or work trail. A lone raven auditor that randomly re-checks past jobs makes duplication risky even at the nadir of activity, when a fresh fake looks cheapest to spin up. Honest agents grow a garden of completed, peer-verified work over time, so a Sybil farmer must pay a new bond and rebuild that history for every fake, while the defender check stays cheap.
